name: CMHC June 2026 Housing Starts And Construction Data
known_limitations: The release supplies metropolitan and provincial stage counts from CMHC surveys. Approved units awaiting a start, units under construction, completions, monthly starts, and trend measures use different stock, flow, timing, and comparison bases; they cannot be treated as a same-project conversion cohort or linked to application 24 254930.
jurisdiction: Canada, Ontario, and Toronto census metropolitan area
automation_notes: Track monthly Toronto and Ontario approved-not-started, under-construction, completion, and starts measures. Do not calculate a permit-to-completion conversion rate without a matched cohort and consistent geography.
notes: Phase 55Q source. The July 16, 2026 release reports June stage measures and schedules the July starts release for August 18, 2026.
